content.text:
Implemented the fix for "Cannot use aggregate over window functions since 4.2" in django/db/models/sql/query.py.

Change: In `Query.get_aggregation()`, added detection of aggregates that reference window-function annotations (`has_window_aggregation`, using `contains_over_clause` on referenced annotations) and included it in the condition that forces the subquery path. This ensures window functions are computed in the inner subquery and the outer aggregate references the resulting column, instead of nesting a window function inside an aggregate call (which PostgreSQL rejects with `aggregate function calls cannot contain window function calls`).

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection ("aggregation") passed — 124 tests, OK.
